math.round_half_rule._: ⭐ 2.5 → 3 rules out bankers' (which gives 2), and -2.5 → -3 rules out toward-zero. The 2-dp case is the sharper one: 0.125 → 0.13 where bankers' would give 0.12. round(3.5) → 4 is the CONTROL — both rules agree there, so it proves the channel is live without discriminating. ⭐⭐ AND IT CONFIRMS THE ENGINE: `interpret.js::POINTWISE.round` and `ast_interpret._guarded_round` both already compute sign(x) * floor(|x| + 0.5), hand-written precisely because neither JS nor Python does this by default.
